title: Little Diyas Shine | Diwali Kids Song for Toddlers | Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful Diwali song about little diyas waking up and lighting the house with warm, happy glow.
It teaches young children to stay safe with sparklers by holding them far away and standing back.
Sing along with the whole family and celebrate the festival of lights together!

Ding ding, little lights, shine bright, stay safe
Ding, ding, ding, ding
Happy lights for everyone!

Do you see the diyas, one by one?
Wake up, wake up, little lights!
Shine, shine, shine, they glow
Now the night is warm and bright!

Brother holds the sparkler, see?
Oh, too close, too close!
Fizz, fizz, fizz, fizz
Amma, please help, please help!

Papa shows us how to hold it
Hold it far, stand back
Back, back, back
Safe and sound, we're on track!

The whole house glows, look around!
Amma smiles, the diyas hum
Glow, glow, glow, glow
Happy Diwali, everyone!
